text:
maria: Quick sync — running into inconsistent cancel/timeout semantics between Node and Python SDKs for streaming endpoints. Node's AbortController seems to cut the TCP stream immediately; Python clients sometimes keep the connection open until the server-side timeout. Anyone seen this?

ajay: saw something similar last week with httpx. I think we weren't wiring the client cancel to the underlying socket close in the python streaming wrapper. short note: 
```py
# python-ish pseudocode
with client.stream('POST', url) as r:
    # we give users a cancel token but we never r.close() on cancel
    pass
```

kevin: Go uses context cancellation and the transport cancels ok:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
req = http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "POST", url, body)
// cancel() will close the request socket and return early
```

sam: CI is flaking on our e2e that intentionally aborts mid-stream — likely because python kept hangers-on and tests hit timeouts. I have a repro in a gist, will drop it in the thread in a sec. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

leah: I can take a quick pass on the python streaming client. Proposed behavior: on user cancel -> immediately r.close() + raise CancelledError to caller. That should mirror Node/Go. Thoughts?

ajay: +1. Also watch for retry middleware — we should not auto-retry aborted requests. Add a flag to the retry policy that treats explicit cancel as non-retryable.

maria: important: we must distinguish user-initiated abort vs network error. user abort -> no retry, immediate close. network hiccup -> follow existing retry/backoff.

kevin: agree. Also note: some servers send keepalives which may leave sockets half-open if client doesn't close. So client-level socket close is necessary.

leah: plan:
- change python stream wrapper to call response.aclose() or response.close() when cancel token triggers
- ensure CancelledError bubbles up and is caught in caller tests
- add unit + small e2e that aborts ~100ms into stream and assert connection closed on server side
- patch retry policy to treat explicit cancel as non-retryable
I'll put up a draft PR today.

maria: awesome — please add a short changelog blurb and mention behavior parity with Node/Go in the SDK docs. Also add a small note in "timeouts and cancellations" doc for language-specific gotchas.

sam: when you open the PR, ping @maria @ajay for review. I'll add the CI repro as a failing test so we don't regress.

devex-bot: CI note — linked flaky repro gist added by sam: https://gist.github.com/redwood/stream-abort-repro

maria: I'll open the tracking issue and link PR once it's up: https://github.com/redwood/inference/issues/1423. Thanks all, this should help stabilize streaming e2e. :thumbsup:
